entry_rationale: Rates default is waived because a new 2027 STIR pay lacks incremental ownership asymmetry. Short USDCAD fades the one-way crowded long.
entry_thesis: The 2027 SOFR and CORRA complex is already two-way on the desk, and cheap-versus-cash is not an entry for a new March CORRA receive while that crowding is flagged. Adding a 2027 pay does not create incremental ownership asymmetry because pays are already a desk position. The remaining one-way crowded expression is the desk long in USDCAD at 1.4246; fading that long is the cleaner ownership-asymmetric trade.
